forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week, 2 visits were completed. No zone surveys, technical surveys or clearances were completed. So far, 30 zones have been surveyed, 11 declared free, and 31 areas released; 15 areas have been cleared, and mines have been found in 10 areas.

The access feed shows 12 zones closed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No reports or dossiers were held, and no new plan was approved; the plan is P11.

The forecast, made in week 45 for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is already done, is 11–13 mine areas cleared this season and 10–11 zones declared free.
